slave 1 replied to "Read Input Registers": 30001 = 4660 (0x1234)

── Data details ──
30001 = 4660 (0x1234)
Note: the response frame carries no start address; numbering starts at 30001 by default — the real start address comes from the matching request

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 05  Length                  5 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
04     Function code           0x04 = Read Input Registers
02     Byte count              2 data bytes
12 34  Data                    every 2 bytes are one register value
